message: The astro target does not support context: Astro renders each component on its own, with no tree of instances to provide to, so `inject` gives its fallback (ADR-0054).
The ember target does not support context: Child components, slots, models, context and the built-in components are not emitted yet. See uxfront-com/unframework#236.
The ember target does not support default-slot: Child components, slots, models, context and the built-in components are not emitted yet. See uxfront-com/unframework#236.
The ember target does not support component: Child components, slots, models, context and the built-in components are not emitted yet. See uxfront-com/unframework#236.
The ember target does not support default-slot: Child components, slots, models, context and the built-in components are not emitted yet. See uxfront-com/unframework#236.
